questions.q: Choose the one word for: a person who does not believe in the existence of God
questions.e: An atheist denies the existence of God.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: government of the people, by the people and for the people
questions.e: Democracy is rule by the people.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: a person who collects postage stamps
questions.e: A philatelist collects stamps; a numismatist collects coins.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: an animal that eats both plants and flesh
questions.e: An omnivore eats both plant and animal food.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: a person who walks in his sleep
questions.e: A somnambulist is a sleepwalker; an insomniac cannot sleep.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: an abnormal fear of closed spaces
questions.e: Claustrophobia is fear of confined spaces. Agoraphobia is fear of open places.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: that which cannot be read
Choose the one word for: the story of a person's life written by that person himself
questions.e: An autobiography is written by the subject; a biography is written by another.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: rule by a small group of people
questions.e: Oligarchy means government by a few. Plutocracy is rule by the wealthy, and anarchy is the absence of government.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: a person who is incapable of being corrected or reformed
questions.e: Incorrigible means impossible to correct. Inexorable means unable to be stopped.
